doc.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019

title: Joining the Navy and being thrown out of the music program
summary: Enlisted as the only alternative to the draft, regretted it at boot camp; the Navy music program dismissed him after about six months.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Well you spent some time at sea, correct?
You mean being in the Navy?
You make it sound like it was my choice. They put me on a ship and sent me out there.
Not much. No. It was a mistake that I discovered in boot camp, my first night in boot camp I went, what have I done?
You mean you volunteered and then you —
Yeah that was the only way to get into the Navy, or you were drafted.
Okay. Were you at a point at that time that you could have maybe done your time as a musician in the Navy?

Yeah they had a music program but they threw me out of it after about six months. There’s a whole story about how that happened and a weird teacher I had who really disliked me a lot, but not more than I disliked him.
